weekly: Introduction to Probability and Sigma Algebras - Basic probability concepts, sample spaces, events, sigma algebras. - Construction of sigma algebras, Borel sigma algebras, generating sigma algebras.

Probability Measures - Definition and properties of probability measures, examples of discrete and continuous measures. - Extension of measures, Carathéodory's Extension Theorem, measurable sets and functions.
Random Variables and Distributions - Random variables as measurable functions, distribution functions.
Independence - Independence of events and random variables. - Product sigma algebras, independent sigma algebras, Borel-Cantelli Lemmas.
Integration with Respect to a Measure - Lebesgue integration, expectations as integrals, properties of expectations. - Monotone convergence theorem, Fatou's lemma, dominated convergence theorem.
Modes of Convergence I - Convergence in probability and almost sure convergence. - Convergence in distribution, relationships between modes of convergence.
Modes of Convergence II - Convergence in \(L^p\), weak law of large numbers (WLLN). - Strong law of large numbers (SLLN), applications of LLNs.
Modes of Convergence III - Detailed proofs and examples of convergence in distribution and almost sure convergence. - Applications of different modes of convergence in probability theory.
Characteristic Functions - Introduction to characteristic functions, properties. - Applications of characteristic functions, inversion theorem.
Central Limit Theorem - Central Limit Theorem (CLT), Lindeberg-Feller CLT. - Proofs and derivations for the CLT.
Conditional Probability and Expectation I - The Radon-Nikodym Theorem. - Conditional expectation, properties, and examples.
Conditional Probability and Expectation II - Conditional expectation and independence
Introduction to Martingales - Introduction to martingales, examples of martingales. - Martingale convergence theorem, applications.
textbooks: Recommended - Textbook: A Probability Path, Sidney Resnick, Modern Birkhauser Classics
Recommended - Textbook: Probability for Statistics and Machine Learning: Fundamentals and Advanced Topics, A. DasGupta, Springer
outcomes: Learn the basic terminology of measure theory
Apply modes of convergence: weak-strong limit theorems, central limit theorem
Learn conditional expectations and martingales
